release_conditions.g02: Pure canonical code may start before selection in an exclusive root Cargo window; no backend dependency or DDL.
release_conditions.g03_and_later_pg: Require P3-P04 Selected(PostgreSQL) in the complete native qualification and independent p3-native-review. A Blocked or NO-GO report does not satisfy this gate. A different selected backend requires a reviewed atomic publication/pin/guard/GC amendment before production storage code.
release_conditions.ready: P7-08 needs G04 typed validation and independent P1 staged-input/P3 content raw-byte golden vectors, plus P7-07 one-connection registration. Graph READY and P7 READY remain closed until all pass.

tasks.summary: P3-G01 SQLx-free Graph records and ports
tasks.acceptance: Named graph_generation_port RED then GREEN. Public exports contain no SQLx types. Production full staging requires an opaque RegisteredFullBuildHandle and cannot insert its own parent; incremental handle and read lease are never authority without DB verification. Ephemeral retention and unscoped keys fail before storage.

Named canonical RED then GREEN; versioned length framing, n-ary participants, sorted sets and maps but ordered TypedValue::List, distinct None/empty, signed nanoseconds and offset round trip. Root Cargo/lock changes occur in one exclusive parent-assigned writer window; no selected backend dependency or DDL is added here.

tasks.summary: P3-G03 selected PostgreSQL Graph schema and real role fence
tasks.acceptance: Only after independently selected PG: additive Graph ledger/schema, P7 target composite FK, immutable parent binding, actual builder/reader/coordinator role tests and child mutation trigger. No second Source pointer, Search0001 writer or Document migration. RED then GREEN on disposable PG18.6.

tasks.summary: P3-G05 Source-owned mapping and current Document access
tasks.acceptance: Snapshot-bound Document/FolderPlacement/Version mapping digest and registered-source validator; same bare IDs across Sources cannot borrow ownership. Current Version/Part/raw/Read/publication and every n-ary participant are rechecked; missing or spoofed mapping fails. Focused real-Document-PG RED then GREEN.

tasks.summary: P3-G04 registered child stage, typed validation and dual Graph golden
tasks.acceptance: Stage only children of a registered BUILDING parent; before P7-07, an isolated coordinator-role fixture registers parent/target/guard in one test transaction and cannot publish. Every batch checks P7 target/Graph parent/full guard/token/fence/DB expiry. Typed validator rereads all rows, attachments, owner mapping, counts and digest but final READY transition belongs to P7-08. Independently compute P1 Source-owned canonical_graph_staged_input_v1 and P3 Core canonical_graph_digest from the same typed records; save distinct raw-byte/golden vectors, reject copied digest, preserve local role, temporal List order and privacy. RED then GREEN under actual PG roles.

tasks.summary: P3-C01 acceptance alias for one Source row and registered guards
tasks.acceptance: Cite real-PG P7-06/07 RED/GREEN for same Search0001 Source pointer and build_fence_seq, one-connection parent/target/guard registration, overflow and expiry rejection, guard before first copy. Audit only; no runtime row, guard port or DDL writer.

tasks.summary: P3-G06 guarded incremental copy and complete relation closure
tasks.acceptance: No copy before P7-registered base/target guard. Each batch locks sorted generations then guard, checks token/fence/DB expiry/base receipt/committed cursor before commit; whole target digest is verified before delta. Relation-only same-ID replacement removes old incidence and complete closure matches full digest/path/evidence; unprovable closure requires full rebuild. RED then GREEN.

tasks.summary: P3-G08 read-only recovery and corruption rejection
tasks.acceptance: Reopen READY with the same key, all rows/indexes, mapping and Graph digest; missing/corrupt data fails closed and rebuild uses a new key. Separate disposable PG dump/restore database preserves receipt and query. Graph-only recovery does not claim P7 lexical or whole-runtime restore. RED then GREEN.

tasks.summary: P3-G07 P7-pin-gated n-ary reader and public-value nonleakage
tasks.acceptance: Only P7-issued lease checked before snapshot and in fresh DB-clock transaction before return; every relation participant receives current Source Read before visible budget. Ordered hit/path/evidence matches memory oracle; hidden branches and missing/Denied/Unknown/Error do not leak public count/status/body. RED then GREEN and residual timing risk recorded.

tasks.summary: P3-C02 acceptance alias for P7 atomic publish and guarded GC
tasks.acceptance: Cite P7-09/11 real-PG CAS-loss guard retention, pointer+Search receipt+guard DELETE one commit, current/pin/base/target guard exclusion, expired cleanup rollback and copy/GC barrier. No P3 public publish or retirement implementation.

tasks.summary: P3-C03 acceptance alias for P7 FK-safe cleanup
tasks.acceptance: Cite actual RESTRICT-FK cleanup order: DELETING, matching guard DELETE, expired lease DELETE, Graph participant/relation/resource, P7 children, Graph/P7 parents in one transaction. Success has no 23503; injected child failure restores guard and target, stale copy/GC cannot observe an unguarded target. No second cleanup code.

tasks.summary: P3-C04 acceptance alias for scoped pin and Graph read/recovery
tasks.acceptance: Cite P7-10 real-PG actor/tenant/Source scoped pin, renew/return/release, two-process publish/pin and expiry during read, plus G08 Graph restart/restore. P7-12 full pointer/guard/lease/lexical restore remains a downstream qualification, not a second P3 pin writer.

tasks.summary: P3-D01 durable Document staging after shared outbox writers
tasks.acceptance: Serialized P1-B03/P6-S04 outbox integration; same authoritative snapshot/key for Projection, Unit, lexical and Graph. Full/incremental Document path uses Source-owned mapping/current access and P7 coordinator; no RAM GraphOwnership authority or generic delivered_at write. Real Document+Search PG RED then GREEN.

tasks.summary: P3-D02 focused durable parity and integration handoff
tasks.acceptance: Durable-only RED then GREEN for identical Source snapshot full/incremental and memory-oracle hit/path/evidence/digest parity; focused graph/source/runtime suites, roles, barrier, fixture/migration hashes and independent review recorded. P7-12 whole-runtime restore and hosted exact-head remain separate gates.

existing_graph_rewrites_for_parent.reason: P7-07 needs only selected Graph repository/registered child-stage seam; aggregate p3-code would cycle through P7 C aliases.
P7-08 is the only final READY commit after two independently computed digest vectors.
P7-11 needs Graph child/FK deletion and base/target copy guard semantics before physical GC.
Make legacy p3-code an aggregate completion gate only; physical code comes from bounded G/D tasks and P7 C owners.
Focused qualification must trace the decomposed receipts.
Independent review examines actual P7 aliases and Graph/Document code without claiming P7 final E2E.
